integrity: All finite computations are transparent and reproducible from the bundled standalone Python program; the infinite-family conclusion follows from a separate written proof. No independent audit or field validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the homogeneous binary epidemic-containment game with 0<T<1, secure cost 1, safe insecure cost 0, vulnerable insecure cost 2, and pure Nash equilibria. This is a mathematical comparative static, not a dynamical prediction or measured protection outcome.
title: An added contact can sharply reduce worst-equilibrium protection cost
